title: Eco-Aesthetic Brand Content Launch

challenge: Manual newsletter writing and visual inconsistency drove low click-throughs.

title: Syllabus, CRM, & Notion Infrastructure

challenge: Advisors lost track of milestones across scattered Google Docs.
solution: Built an integrated Notion Hub with relational tables, automated via Zapier.
outcome: Consolidated comms and frictionless onboarding for 12 high-ticket clients.

title: Signature Onboarding Automation Flow
description: Designed a high-fidelity contract-signing and onboarding sequence triggered by leads.
challenge: Lead response times of up to 72 hours cooled warm prospects.
solution: Linked Honeybook to forms via Zapier with auto contract drafting and Slack alerts.
outcome: Onboarding processing reduced to under 5 minutes; instant response confirmation.
